args: import hashlib,json,pathlib,runpy,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin); root=pathlib.Path(json.loads(p['request'])['output_root']); root.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False); [(root/name).write_text(p[key]) for key,name in [('source','inventory.py'),('request','INVENTORY_REQUEST.json'),('freeze','SOURCE_FREEZE.json')]]; f=json.loads(p['freeze']); assert hashlib.sha256((root/'inventory.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['files']['inventory.py']; assert hashlib.sha256((root/'INVENTORY_REQUEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['files']['INVENTORY_REQUEST.json']; sys.argv=[str(root/'inventory.py'),str(root/'INVENTORY_REQUEST.json')]; runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
